stage: Single Windows default Host chronology acceptance for notified_v1
plan_provenance: New Windows plan generated 2026-10-22 from the exact persisted candidate identities and approved finite scope. Not a recovered original manifest. No cloud repository reconstruction or new source implementation is required.

source.identity_note: Commit identifiers are historical provenance. Verify exact file tree, including tracked modes and gitlink pins; synthetic local recovery history must not be presented as original history.

environment.target: Previously authorized Windows computer and original independent acceptance copy; no local path or device identifier is published.
environment.toolchain: Existing official Zig 0.16.0; record actual version and native target.
environment.device_backend: null_backend from the unmodified existing test fixture
environment.unexpected_environment: If any additional SME_LIVE_SEMANTIC_* or SME_LIVE_ADMISSION_* variable is present, stop for review rather than silently inherit it. Do not introduce artificial delays or force a favorable seed.

preflight: Verify existing original working files with the established read-only protection inventory; do not alter them. Work only in the original independent acceptance copy.
Verify exact base tree and the downloaded patch bytes/SHA before applying it once. Do not apply on an unrelated tree or overwrite user edits.
After application verify exact candidate tree; leave all tests, assertions, PCM capacity, runtime buffers and dependencies unchanged.
Verify there is no related existing build or test process that would duplicate this run. Record actual environment configuration without credentials or private paths.
Do not run preparatory project tests, extra build targets or diagnostic workloads.

execution.timeout_scope: One total build-and-test wall-clock deadline, using the established bounded Windows acceptance runner.
execution.timeout_behavior: On deadline, use the established process-tree termination/cleanup procedure; preserve timeout and incomplete cleanup as such. Do not claim graceful cleanup without evidence.
execution.retry_policy: No timing retry, rerun to select a favorable outcome, assertion weakening, capacity increase, panel run, ReleaseSafe run or extra matrix.

evidence_required: Record actual exit code, elapsed time, build summary, actual test totals and crashes/timeouts; expected target currently contains 12 tests, but report actual counts.
Verify the native Host fixture actually asserts/prints DEFAULT_HOST_PACING mode=notified_v1 ordinary=true. Diagnostic self-tests alone do not establish playback success.
Determine first Play execution, sustained exact PCM/four-stem oracle, Stop execution, Close/join and resource-cleanup assertions from the real run. Preserve the first failure and its phase.
On failure retain existing bounded flat diagnostics and PCM-capacity diagnostic without adding instrumentation or inferring missing fields.
Distinguish ordinary observed mode and serializer tests from a dedicated full raw-log parser qualification, which has not been performed.
Retain raw logs locally. Public summary includes only command, version/tree/hash identity, test counts and necessary failure explanation, not raw logs, binary files, credentials or local paths.
After the run check protected original files and related processes. If counts or cleanup state were not emitted or proven by completed assertions, report unknown rather than zero.
capability_limits: Notification pacing applies only to ordinary non-recording Host. Semantic capture/replay and private capture remain legacy_poll.
This single Windows acceptance does not qualify new notification recording/replay, all histories, all devices or universal real-time deadlines.
Earlier Windows sustained-playback failures and cloud results remain independent evidence; do not replace or relabel them.
post_run: Report the result to the user. Publish only the approved sanitized result on the existing delivery branch, as a separate result record. No main branch modification.
